- Charlie is young. (Fact)
- If someone is young then they are cold. (Rule 2)  
  → Charlie is cold. (from Charlie is young)
- Charlie is young and cold. (combine Charlie is young and Charlie is cold)
- All cold, young people are red. (Rule 6)  
  → Charlie is red. (from Charlie is young and cold)
- Charlie is red and young. (from Charlie is red and Charlie is young)
- All red, young people are smart. (Rule 1)  
  → Charlie is smart. (from Charlie is red and young)
- Therefore “Charlie is not smart” contradicts the derived fact that Charlie is smart, so it does not follow.

ANSWER: False
